outline:
依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

週次	單元主題（中文）	Unit Topic (English)
第1週	課程介紹與工程倫理的重要性	Course Introduction & Importance of Engineering Ethics
第2週	工程師的社會責任與公共利益	Social Responsibility and Public Welfare of Engineers
第3週	工程倫理概述與倫理理論基礎	Overview of Engineering Ethics and Ethical Theories
第4週	工程專業精神與誠信原則	Professionalism and Integrity in Engineering
第5週	工程實務中的倫理衝突	Ethical Conflicts in Engineering Practice
第6週	工程倫理抉擇與決策模式	Ethical Decision-Making Models for Engineers
第7週	工程倫理守則概論	Codes of Engineering Ethics
第8週	工程倫理守則之解說與應用	Interpretation and Application of Engineering Codes
第9週	期中考試	Midterm Exam
第10週	工程安全、風險與責任	Safety, Risk and Responsibility in Engineering
第11週	工程失誤、災害與倫理反思	Engineering Failures, Disasters and Ethical Reflections
第12週	工程與法律責任之關係	Engineering Ethics and Legal Responsibility
第13週	專業判斷、利益衝突與吹哨者	Professional Judgment, Conflicts of Interest and Whistleblowing
第14週	永續發展與工程倫理	Sustainability and Engineering Ethics
第15週	工程倫理個案分析 I	Case Studies in Engineering Ethics I
第16週	工程倫理個案分析 II	Case Studies in Engineering Ethics II
第17週	工程倫理在現代科技中的挑戰	Ethical Challenges in Modern Engineering and Technology
第18週	期末考試	Final Exam
